paper_title: Spectrum of global string networks and the axion dark matter mass
notes: This is a theoretical/numerical simulation paper predicting the post-inflationary QCD axion dark matter mass range (m_a ~ 95-450 ueV) from global string network spectrum simulations. It is not an experimental exclusion limit or sensitivity projection on a coupling constant. The main result is a predicted mass range, not a curve in coupling-mass space. No extractable (mass, coupling) data points for a standard exclusion plot are provided.
